notes.title: The PIXELJAM COMPLETE Megabundle + DLC Supporter Packs Are Live
notes.content:
Hello all,

Yesterday we launched [b]PIXELJAM COMPLETE[/b], a massive collection that brings together 14 years of our creative output in a single bundle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6883465/52afdd3b33033872257b632aab4595fb34aa93bf.png[/img]

[list]
[*] 20+ games & soundtracks
[*] Prototypes & alphas from projects we never finished
[*] Wallpapers, design sketches, art, gifs, comics, music & more
[/list]

[b]You can find it here: [url=https://pixeljam.itch.io/pixeljam-complete]pixeljam.itch.io/pixeljam-complete[/url][/b]

In tandem with this bundle, we are also rolling out "supporter packs" for each of our games on Steam, that contain sketches, concept art, gifs, wallpapers & soundtracks:

(click each game for its supporter pack)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159130/Cheap_Golf_SUSAN_Supporter_Pack/]Cheap Golf[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/335170/Potatoman_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Potatoman Seeks The Troof[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/383140/Glorkian_Warrior_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Glorkian Warrior[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/424950/Last_Horizon_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Last Horizon[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/510800/Dino_Run_DX_OST/]Dino Run DX[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159270/Gamma_Bros_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Gamma Bros[/url] (Launches Oct 21)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160350/Snowball_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Snowball![/url] (Launches Oct 21)

If you just want the goodies for 1 or 2 of our games, the Steam DLC's are the way to go.  However, each of them are only about 1% of the total contents of the Pixeljam Complete bundle, which is overall a much better value.

Also, if you'd like to help boost our launch signal, [url=https://twitter.com/pixeljamgames/status/1184125853371949056]click here[/url].

Thanks for the ongoing support!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: Major Update Coming This Thursday!
notes.content:
Hello all,

Just a head's up that we will be adding a new game mode to Last Horizon this Thursday (Feb 22):  ESCAPE!

It's the most challenging flight by far, and has more of an arcade feel to it than the other ones, which are more exploratory and calm.

It will be unlocked for everyone to play, regardless of past progress, although we don't recommend trying it until you've beaten a few previous flights.

We hope you will enjoy it!

-Miles @ Pixeljam
